description: x402-polyperp-quotes: Live quotes for Polymarket Perps markets — index price, mark price, last traded price, mid, open interest, the current hourly funding rate and its annualised equivalent, and when funding is next charged. Also reports how far the mark sits from the index in basis points, which is the number that tells you whether the perpetual is trading rich or cheap versus its underlying. One call without a symbol returns the whole board; pass symbol to price a single market.
name: x402-polyperp-quotes
